name: handover
title_zh: 会话快满时自动写好交接文档
tagline_zh: 上下文快爆、回复变慢、开始忘事？它把目标、进度、坑位写成带标签的交接单，新会话零提示自动接住。
tagline_en: Context near full, replies slowing, memory fading? It writes a tagged handover (goal, state, next steps.
desc_en: End a long session cleanly and hand it to a fresh chat. Writes a lane-tagged handover doc (goal, state, in-flight work, next steps, decisions, landmines) that the next session picks up automatically from a bare "continue" - no prompt to paste. Use when the context guard fires AMBER/RED/CRITICAL, when context is large or the session feels slow or forgetful, when switching to an unrelated task, or w
why_zh: 不是摘要，是带车道标签的结构化交接：决策、未完成、雷区各自归位。新会话裸读就能续。
why_en: Not a summary—a lane-tagged handover where decisions, loose ends, and landmines each have their own slot. A bare "continue".
limit_zh: 只在上下文警戒触发或你主动调用时生成；不自动监控会话健康度。交接文档是纯文本，不迁移工具状态（如未提交的编辑。
limit_en: Only fires on context warning or manual call; no passive monitoring. Output is plain text—doesn't migrate tool state (uncommitted edits, temp vars).
title_en: Auto-write handover doc when context is full; next chat.
